mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO learning_activity_event (id, user_id, event_type, occurred_at, plan_id, unit_id, material_id, entry_id, quantity, duration_seconds, result_code, idempotency_key, status, claim_token, processed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{eventType}, #{occurredAt}, #{planId}, #{unitId}, #{materialId}, #{entryId}, #{quantity}, #{durationSeconds}, #{resultCode}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{claimToken}, #{processedTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted}, #{version})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_activity_event SET status = 'processing', claim_token = #{claimToken}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, event_type, occurred_at, plan_id, unit_id, material_id, entry_id, quantity, duration_seconds, result_code, idempotency_key, status, claim_token, processed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted, version FROM learning_activity_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'processing' AND claim_token = #{claimToken} ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_activity_event SET status = 'succeeded', claim_token = NULL, processed_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'processing' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}
UPDATE learning_activity_event SET status = 'pending', claim_token = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'processing' AND update_time < #{cutoffTime}
